chunks.en:
The static spherically symmetric body in relativistic
elasticity
chunks.zh:
相对论
弹性力学中的静态球对称物体

chunks.en: In this paper is discussed a class of static spherically symmetric  solutions of the general relativistic elasticity equations. The main  point of discussion is the comparison of two matter models given in  terms of their stored energy functionals, i.e., the rule which gives  the amount of energy stored in the system when it is deformed. Both  functionals mimic (and for small deformations approximate) the  classical Kirchhoff-St.~Venant materials but differ in the strain  variable used. We discuss the behavior of the systems for large  deformations.
chunks.zh: 本文讨论了一类广义相对论弹性力学方程的静态球对称解。讨论的重点是比较两种以其储能泛函表述的物质模型，即给出系统发生形变时所储存能量大小的规则。两种泛函都模拟（并在小形变情形下近似）经典的 Kirchhoff-St.~Venant 材料，但所使用的应变变量不同。我们讨论了这些系统在大形变情形下的行为。

chunks.en: Introduction
chunks.zh: 引言

chunks.en: Classical elasticity is a phenomenological theory to describe the properties of solids. It is used heavily in applications such as structural mechanics and other engineering disciplines. This also explains the influence of classical elasticity in the formulation of the popular finite element method for the numerical solution of partial differential equations (see e.g.~[[CITE_8]]). While it is entirely sufficient to restrict oneself to a classical theory for bulk matter to describe every-day engineering problems it is nevertheless of conceptual interest to formulate a theory of elasticity which is compatible with the space-time structure established by Einstein's theories of relativity.
chunks.zh: 经典弹性力学是一门描述固体性质的现象学理论。它被广泛应用于结构力学及其他工程学科等领域。这也解释了经典弹性力学在用于数值求解偏微分方程的流行有限元方法之构建中的影响（参见例如~[[CITE_8]]）。尽管对于描述日常工程问题而言，将自身局限于经典的体物质理论已完全足够，但构建一种与 Einstein 相对论所确立的时空结构相容的弹性理论，仍然在概念上具有重要意义。

chunks.en: The first attempts to merge elasticity with special relativity go back to the early 20th century and there have been several other formulations including Synge~[[CITE_9]] and Rayner~[[CITE_10]]. The most influential work, however, has been the paper by Carter and Quintana~[[CITE_11]] who formulated the geometric setting for the theory and derived the basic field equations. The theory has also been considered from a field theoretical point of view by Kijowski and Magli~[[CITE_12]]. Recently, the theory has been analyzed from the point of view of the initial value problem formulation by Beig and Schmidt~[[CITE_13]]. They showed that the field equations can be put into a first order symmetric hyperbolic form and they prove among other things that the Cauchy problem for the system is well-posed under various circumstances. Based on this formulation it is shown in~[[CITE_14]] that there exist solutions of the elasticity equations in Newtonian theory and in special relativity describing elastic bodies in rigid rotation. In~[[CITE_15]] it is proved that there exist solutions of the static elastic equations for sufficiently weak gravitational interaction. Losert~[[CITE_16]] analyzes the case of a self-gravitating elastic spherical shell and shows existence of solutions in the Newtonian case.
chunks.zh: 将弹性与狭义相对论相结合的最早尝试可以追溯到20世纪初，此后还出现了若干其他表述形式，包括 Synge~[[CITE_9]] 和 Rayner~[[CITE_10]] 的工作。然而，最具影响力的工作是 Carter 和 Quintana~[[CITE_11]] 的论文，他们为该理论建立了几何框架，并推导出了基本的场方程。Kijowski 和 Magli~[[CITE_12]] 也从场论的角度对该理论进行了研究。最近，Beig 和 Schmidt~[[CITE_13]] 从初值问题表述的角度分析了该理论。他们证明了场方程可以写成一阶对称双曲形式，并且除其他结果外，还证明了该系统的 Cauchy 问题在多种情形下是适定的。基于这一表述，~[[CITE_14]] 中证明了在牛顿理论和狭义相对论中存在描述刚性旋转弹性体的弹性方程解。在~[[CITE_15]] 中证明了当引力相互作用足够弱时，静态弹性方程存在解。Losert~[[CITE_16]] 分析了自引力弹性球壳的情形，并证明了牛顿情形下解的存在性。

chunks.en: In a series of papers[[CITE_17]] Karlovini, Samuelsson and Zarroug adopt the formulation of Carter and Quintana to discuss spherically symmetric equilibrium configurations and their radial perturbations. They also present an exact static and spherically symmetric solution with constant energy density.
chunks.zh: 在一系列论文[[CITE_17]]中，Karlovini、Samuelsson 和 Zarroug 采用 Carter 和 Quintana 的表述来讨论球对称平衡位形及其径向扰动。他们还给出了一个具有恒定能量密度的精确静态球对称解。

chunks.en: Our intention in this paper is to discuss two different equations of state in the static and spherically symmetric context with two different materials. In~[[CITE_18]] the familiar Kirchhoff-St.~Venant stored energy functional for hyper-elastic isotropic materials has been extended to the relativistic case. Recall that this functional is quadratic in the strain variable and contains the Lam\'e coefficients as two material constants. Kijowski and Magli in~[[CITE_19]] use the same functional. However, they adopt a different definition for their strain variable which has a non-linear relationship to the strain used by Beig-Schmidt. Hence, this results in two different stored energy functionals which have the property that, by construction, they agree with the classical Kirchhoff-St.-Venant functional in the non-relativistic, small deformation limit.
chunks.zh: 本文旨在静态球对称背景下，针对两种不同的材料讨论两种不同的状态方程。在~[[CITE_18]] 中，适用于超弹性各向同性材料的经典 Kirchhoff-St.~Venant 储能泛函被推广到了相对论情形。回顾可知，该泛函关于应变变量是二次的，并包含作为两个材料常数的 Lam\'e 系数。Kijowski 和 Magli 在~[[CITE_19]] 中使用了相同的泛函。然而，他们对应变变量采用了不同的定义，该定义与 Beig-Schmidt 所使用的应变之间呈非线性关系。因此，这产生了两种不同的储能泛函，它们具有如下性质：按构造，在非相对论、小变形极限下，它们均与经典的 Kirchhoff-St.-Venant 泛函一致。

chunks.en: The plan of the paper is as follows. In sec.~[[REF_20]] we provide the necessary background on the formulation of the theory of relativistic elasticity. The exposition follows that of~[[CITE_21]]. We present the two formulations by Beig-Schmidt and Kijowski-Magli and point out their differences. It turns out that the only difference is in the definition of the strain variable which accounts for the above mentioned different energy functionals.
chunks.zh: 本文的结构安排如下。在第~[[REF_20]]节中，我们介绍相对论弹性理论表述所需的背景知识。该部分的阐述遵循~[[CITE_21]]。我们给出 Beig-Schmidt 和 Kijowski-Magli 的两种表述，并指出它们之间的差异。结果表明，唯一的差异在于应变变量的定义，而这正是导致上述不同能量泛函的原因。

chunks.en: In sec.~[[REF_22]] we specialize to the static and spherically symmetric case and derive the equations which govern this situation. We show that this system of equations has a unique smooth solution once the central compression of the body has been specified.
chunks.zh: 在第~[[REF_22]]节中，我们专门讨论静态且球对称的情形，并推导支配该情形的方程。我们证明，一旦给定物体的中心压缩量，该方程组便具有唯一的光滑解。

chunks.en: Sec.~[[REF_23]] is devoted to a study of various models. In order to compare the two energy functionals we consider various scenarios. We discuss a solid aluminum sphere and a relativistic highly compact material similar to the nucleonic matter inside a neutron star, described with both theories as well as with the classical theory of elasticity. We also discuss how the choice of different natural states affects the solutions.
chunks.zh: 第~[[REF_23]]节致力于研究各种模型。为了比较两种能量泛函，我们考虑了多种情形。我们讨论了一个实心铝球以及一种类似于中子星内部核子物质的相对论性高致密物质，并分别用两种理论以及经典弹性理论对其进行描述。我们还讨论了不同自然状态的选择如何影响解。

chunks.en: The main difference between the Beig-Schmidt~[[CITE_110]] and Kijowski-Magli~[[CITE_111]] formulations is the choice of the variable which measures the deformation. Beig-Schmidt use the difference between the actual and the relaxed metrics on the body while Kijowski-Magli use a logarithmic variable. They claim that this variable has better behavior when large deformations are studied.

Both theories are quadratic in their respective deformation variables and therefore describe in some sense a Hookean theory in which stress and strain are proportional. chunks.en: In the rest of this paper we solve the system~([[REF_261]]) for several specific matter models. We consider two situations, a sphere consisting entirely of an ordinary material such as aluminum and a sphere which consists of material which resembles the neutron star crust. In both cases we choose the two different energy functionals corresponding to the BS and KM formulation, respectively. For aluminum we use the values [[MATH_262]], [[MATH_263]] and [[MATH_264]].

In the crust of a neutron star the density increases from the outer layer with [[MATH_266]] to the inner edge where the density is approximately [[MATH_267]]. While the ground state of the matter is a lattice which has anisotropic elastic properties it is customary to approximate it by a homogeneous and isotropic elastic material. chunks.en: Conclusion
chunks.zh: 结论

chunks.en: We have discussed in this work the spherically symmetric body in relativistic elasticity for two different stored energy functionals. We find that the BS-functional corresponding to the classical Kirchhoff-St.~Venant materials and the KM-functional have entirely different behavior for large deformations even though they agree for small deformations. The BS-functional gives rise to a mass-radius diagram which qualitatively is very similar to the one found by Karlovini and Samuelsson in~[[CITE_420]]. They obtain this diagram for a stiff ultra-rigid equation of state in the Carter-Quintana high-pressure formulation. They find that the decreasing branch is unstable. We can confirm this numerically and we even see indications of another region of configurations. This is an indication that the BS-functional gives rise to an increasingly stiff equation of state quite in contrast to the KM-functional for which the equation of state becomes increasingly soft. The result of this softness can be seen in qualitatively very different behavior of the mass-radius diagram which shows a spiral which approaches a limit point for large deformations.
chunks.zh: 本文针对两种不同的储能泛函，讨论了相对论弹性力学中的球对称物体。我们发现，对应于经典 Kirchhoff-St.~Venant 材料的 BS 泛函与 KM 泛函在大变形情形下表现出完全不同的行为，尽管二者在小变形情形下是一致的。BS 泛函所给出的质量-半径图在定性上与 Karlovini 和 Samuelsson 在~[[CITE_420]] 中得到的结果非常相似。他们是在 Carter-Quintana 高压表述下针对刚性超刚物态方程得到该图的。他们发现下降分支是不稳定的。我们通过数值计算证实了这一点，甚至还看到了另一组位形区域存在的迹象。这表明 BS 泛函所对应的物态方程越来越刚硬，这与 KM 泛函形成了鲜明对比——后者的物态方程变得越来越软。这种柔软性的结果可以从质量-半径图定性上截然不同的行为中看出：该图呈现一条螺旋线，在大变形情形下趋近于一个极限点。

chunks.en: We looked at these functionals for two different materials, the `every day' material aluminum and an artificial exotic material. While the sizes of the individual configurations are very different the qualitative behavior is very similar in both cases.
chunks.zh: 我们针对两种不同的材料考察了这些泛函，即"日常"材料铝和一种人工构造的奇异材料。尽管各个位形的尺寸差异很大，但两种情形下的定性行为非常相似。

chunks.en: In order to analyze in more detail the features in these configurations and in particular the stability properties of the different branches of the mass-radius diagrams it might be advantageous to formulate the problem not as an initial value problem as we have done here. Instead of specifying the central compression and integrating outwards to (possibly) find the boundary of a configuration one would instead set up a boundary value problem on the body subject to the boundary conditions imposed by the symmetry requirements in the center and the vanishing of the radial pressure on the boundary. Steps in this direction have already been made by Losert~[[CITE_421]].
chunks.zh: 为了更详细地分析这些构型中的特征，特别是质量-半径图中不同分支的稳定性性质，将问题表述为边值问题而非像本文这样表述为初值问题可能更为有利。与其给定中心压缩程度并向外积分以（可能）找到构型的边界，不如在物体上建立一个边值问题，其边界条件由中心处的对称性要求以及边界上径向压强为零的条件所施加。Losert~[[CITE_421]] 已经在这个方向上迈出了步伐。

chunks.en: Of course, our considerations are to a certain point academic because any real material will break at already quite moderate deformations compared to the ones we have used. But we feel that such questions of principle may shed some light on the differences between the various possible choices and therefore on the justification of assumptions made when relativistic elasticity is used for real problems.
chunks.zh: 当然，我们的考虑在一定程度上是学术性的，因为与我们使用的变形相比，任何真实材料在相当适度的变形下就会断裂。但我们认为，这类原则性问题或许有助于阐明各种可能选择之间的差异，从而有助于说明在将相对论弹性理论用于实际问题时所作假设的合理性。
